metadata.title: chore(logging): migrate f-string log calls to lazy %-style in services
metadata.author: msureshkumar88

description:
## Summary

- Migrate ~1000+ `logger.<level>(f"...")` calls in `mcpgateway/services/` to lazy `%-style` interpolation
- Enable `G004` in `pyproject.toml` ruff lint select to enforce the rule going forward
- Add `scripts/fix_logging_fstrings.py` — the libcst codemod used to perform the bulk migration

## Motivation

f-string arguments are evaluated at the call site regardless of log level. On disabled levels (e.g. DEBUG in production), this wastes CPU allocating strings that are never printed. Lazy `%-style` defers interpolation to the logging framework, which skips it entirely when the level is filtered out.

This satisfies the documented convention in `AGENTS.md`: _"Lazy logging style preferred"_, and is caught automatically by `ruff G004` / pylint `W1203`.

## Scope

`mcpgateway/services/` only (~65 service files). Files outside this directory (routers, transports, middleware) are out of scope and addressed in a follow-up.

## Ruff enforcement

`G004` added to `[tool.ruff.lint] select` in `pyproject.toml`. New f-string log calls are now caught by `ruff check` and blocked by the pre-commit hook automatically — no hook config change needed.

Closes #4617

commits.message:
chore(logging): migrate f-string log calls to lazy %-style in services

Converts ~970 f-string logging calls across 46 service files to deferred
%-style interpolation, eliminating unnecessary string allocation when log
levels are disabled. Adds G004 to ruff lint select to enforce the
convention going forward.

- Automated via scripts/fix_logging_fstrings.py (regex-based codemod)
- Manual fixes for multi-line, structured_logger, and mixed-concat cases
- Fixes pre-existing %%.2f formatting bugs in metrics_cleanup_service and
  performance_tracker where format specs were not consumed correctly
- Preserves all SecurityValidator.sanitize_log_message() calls as args
- Preserves exc_info/stack_info/extra kwargs on all affected calls

Closes #4617

Signed-off-by: Suresh Kumar Moharajan <suresh.kumar.m@ibm.com>
commits.author: Suresh Kumar Moharajan

commits.message:
fix(logging): fix StructuredLogger compat and broken format specs in tests

- Revert structured_logger calls in a2a_service and tool_service to
  f-strings (StructuredLogger.info/error only accept **kwargs, not
  positional %s args); suppress G004 with noqa since the API requires it
- Fix performance_tracker.record_timing: %%.2f -> %.2f (pre-existing bug
  where second arg was never consumed by the format string)
- Update test assertions in test_argon2_service, test_mcp_client_chat_service,
  and test_metrics_exception_coverage to match new %-style log call
  signatures (format_str, *args) instead of interpolated single strings

Signed-off-by: Suresh Kumar Moharajan <suresh.kumar.m@ibm.com>
commits.author: Suresh Kumar Moharajan

commits.message:
fix: correct %%.Nf → %.Nf in converted log format strings

Five PLE1205 errors from prior lazy-logging conversion where %%
was used instead of % for float format specifiers, producing
literal '%' and mismatched argument counts.
